paras: Ctenophorus nguyarna, commonly known as the Lake Disappointment dragon is a species of agamid lizard occurring in low samphire shrubs fringing the remote Kumpupintil Lake (previously Lake Disappointment), Western Australia.
Nguyarna is the Kartujarra word for Kumpupintil Lake, the lizard's habitat.
The lizard is one of the most threatened Australian reptile species.
